review_candidates.title: Acquisition Manager
review_candidates.description: At Remote Latinos, we are seeking a bilingual Acquisition Manager to join our selection process for a U.S.-based real estate investment company that buys properties directly from homeowners and assigns those contracts to a network of cash buyers. You'll be the first voice motivated sellers hear and the person who gets the deal signed, with full CRM, scripts, contracts, video training and daily coaching from leadership. Compensation: $10 USD/hour base + 3–5% commission on every closed deal, plus a performance bonus structure (a higher-percentage commission-only track is also available) Schedule: Full-time, aligned to U.S. Pacific Time (PST), with daily training built in; immediate start Location: Remote – Latin America What You'll Do Speed to Lead: Contact every new seller lead within 5 minutes. Follow-Up Cadence: Make multiple call attempts over each lead's first 7 days to hold an 80%+ contact rate. Qualification: Qualify sellers on property, condition, timeline and motivation using proven scripts. Offers: Make an offer on nearly every conversation, about one per day. Contracts: Negotiate and sign purchase agreements, converting at least 1 in 10 offers. Expectation Setting: Keep deals together through inspection and closing with honest communication. CRM & Reporting: Log every call and note, send an accurate end-of-day report, and handle Spanish-speaking sellers end to end. Non-Negotiable Requirements Phone Experience: Proven experience in a results-driven phone role such as sales, call center or appointment setting. High Volume: Comfortable with high-volume calling and hearing "no" all day. Bilingual: Advanced English (C1+) and native or fluent Spanish. CRM Discipline: Strong attention to detail and clean record-keeping. Reliability: Punctual and consistent every day. Coachable: You apply training fast and turn feedback into better numbers. Performance Driven: Motivated by commission and upside. Nice-to-Have Formal sales training or a record of beating quotas Sales team leadership High-volume call center background U.S. real estate, investing or wholesaling exposure

review_candidates.title: Account Executive, Affiliate Marketing
review_candidates.description: Position: Account Specialist, Affiliate Marketing The Account Specialist position is a remote, work-from-home role, as are all positions at Acceleration Partners (a structure central to our culture and vision to change the work/life paradigm). Some travel may be required for client meetings, internal meetings, conferences, and other events. Please note: This role requires fluency in both German and English. The Role: As an Account Specialist , you will be responsible for the day-to-day operations of multiple affiliate programs. The ideal candidate will have 1-2 years of work experience. Affiliate marketing experience is not required. You will manage affiliate communications, reporting, and general account maintenance, including recruitment, newsletters, fraud checks, and data analysis. You’ll work closely with your manager and peers to maximize program effectiveness and create opportunities for growth. Duties are performed across one or more assigned client accounts, which will vary over time. Top 5 Responsibilities: Account & Client Communication Build and maintain client and affiliate communications, including creative newsletters and updates about promotions, program developments, and general client information. Develop relationships with clients and partners to understand their goals and objectives, providing clear and proactive communication across channels. Reporting & Data Management Utilize Excel (pivot tables, v-lookups, etc.) to produce detailed reports, track performance, and analyze data for insights and trends. Summarize findings and provide actionable recommendations to optimize program performance. Proactively track key metrics and report on campaign performance. Strategy Execution & Task Ownership Own and manage client tasks with minimal supervision, ensuring deadlines are met and tasks are completed accurately. Prioritize tasks effectively, flagging any potential delays and keeping the team informed. Consistently leverage tools and client tracking platforms to support program goals. Program & Portfolio Management Manage multiple affiliate campaigns, maintaining a balanced focus across each, and organizing tasks by priority. Identify areas for process improvement, and provide proactive support to peers and clients. Manage risks, track fraud, and ensure compliance with program terms and conditions. Team Collaboration & Growth Collaborate with peers and management to contribute ideas for process improvements and training. Serve as a resource for peers and help drive continuous improvement across the team, sharing best practices and insights. What Success Looks Like: By 6 Months: You will be proficient in the day-to-day operations of multiple affiliate programs, including managing reporting, affiliate applications, recruitment, and creative asset deployment. You will regularly present new campaign ideas to managers and demonstrate a clear understanding of program performance, ensuring regular fraud checks and compliance. You will have developed strong relationships with clients and affiliates and will be able to execute tasks with minimal guidance. By 1 Year: You will troubleshoot and resolve account and affiliate issues independently, providing valuable insights and actionable recommendations to clients and internal teams. You will be an integral part of each program, developing new ideas and improving processes to create efficiencies. You will take on new account responsibilities with support from your manager and serve as a thought leader within the team, contributing to relationship-building and firm development. Qualities of the Ideal Candidate Strong sense of curiosity Critical thinker Confident and comfortable being uncomfortable Flexible, resilient, coachable Relationship and service oriented Proactive and outcome oriented Strong work ethic and personal standards Qualifications & Skills: Fluency in German 1-2 years of experience- background in online marketing, e-commerce, or affiliate marketing beneficial. Familiarity with affiliate networks and SaaS platforms (e.g., ShareASale, Commission Junction, Impact) is a plus. Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience. Advanced proficiency in Excel (v-lookups, pivot tables, formatting, etc.). Knowledge of HTML is a plus. Ability to travel when necessary for conferences and team meetings. WHY ACCELERATION PARTNERS? Acceleration Partners is the world’s largest and first-to-market Partnership Marketing Agency creating and nurturing partnerships that drive exceptional measurable outcomes for their clients. Managing clients in 40+ countries, their global team of 300+ focuses on data-driven strategies that help connect brands to the right consumers through performance partnerships, traditional affiliate, influencer, performance PR, content and B2B partnership marketing. AP Perks & Benefits - What We Offer 100% remote work for everyone Unlimited Paid Time Off Summer & Holiday Wellness Breaks in July and December Volunteer and Birthday Time Off Focus Fridays (no internal meetings) Paid Parental Leave Benefits Wellness, Technology & Education Allowance Paid sabbatical leaves, donation matching, and more!! Target salary range: £27–37K depending on location and experience Benefits may vary based on employment status or country location. Acceleration Partners is committed to a diverse workforce and we are an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate applicants regardless of an individual's age, race, color, gender, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, disability, or veteran status. By submitting your application you are agreeing to Acceleration Partners processing your personal data for the purposes of recruitment related activities. To understand more about our privacy policy, click HERE *GLSDR

review_candidates.description: NHS Scotland is committed to encouraging equality and diversity among our workforce and eliminating unlawful discrimination. The aim is for our workforce to be truly representative and for each employee to feel respected and able to give their best. To this end, NHS Scotland welcomes applications from all sections of society. AI tools like ChatGPT or Copilot can be great for planning and preparing your application—but your answers must be your own. Show us the real you: Your application should reflect your skills, experience, and motivations authentically. Use AI wisely: It’s fine to use AI for ideas or to check spelling and grammar, but don’t let it write your answers. Why this matters: Applications that rely on AI-generated content may be withdrawn. By applying, you confirm your responses are based on your own knowledge and achievements. Tip: Think of AI as a helper, not a substitute. We want to understand you—not an AI tool. Royal Hospital for Children & Young People Edinburgh Radiology Directorate Band 6 Specialist Radiographer – Full-Time (36 hours) & Part Time (28.8 hours) Permanent Applications for Part- Time working will be considered We are seeking a motivated, enthusiastic and conscientious radiographer with paediatric imaging experience. Applications are invited for the position of Specialist Radiographer in the RHCYP imaging department. This post will provide an excellent opportunity for the successful candidate to further develop their existing paediatric knowledge and skills. The paediatric department is situated in a purpose-built facility on the Bioquarter site in Edinburgh, adjacent to the Royal Infirmary and is co-joined with the Radiology Department in the Dept of Clinical Neurosciences. This post supports the services on the new site and provides an excellent opportunity for the successful candidate to gain further experience in paediatric imaging. The successful applicant will work with state-of-the-art equipment and includes the potential to work on cross sectional scanners in both paediatric and adult settings in CT/MRI. The successful applicant will be required to participate in the 5/7 roster which includes out of hours/weekends and overnight on-call Applicants should have relevant postgraduate experience. Please note: The use of AI to write applications is being monitored and if used please declare this on your application. For Further Information Please Contact Jayne Davison Radiography Team Leader 0131 312 0827 Jayne.davison@nhs.scot Louisa Armstrong Principal Radiographer 0131 312 0830 louisa.armstrong2@nhs.scot To work in the United Kingdom, there is a legal requirement for an individual to demonstrate that they have the relevant permission to work in the country. This permission is, without exception, granted by the UK Visa and Immigrations Service. Further information on what NHS Scotland Boards are required to do to check this as well as what your responsibilities include can be found in the further information for this vacancy. Please note: we anticipate a high level of interest in this position and may close the vacancy early once a sufficient amount of applications are received. Therefore, please make sure you complete and submit your application at an early stage. We will fully support disabled candidates, and candidates with long-term conditions or who are neurodivergent by making reasonable adjustments to our recruitment policy and practices. This post requires the post holder to have a PVG Scheme membership/record. If the post holder is not a current PVG member for the required regulatory group (i.e. child and/or adult) then an application will need to be made to Disclosure Scotland and deemed satisfactory before they can begin in post.

review_candidates.title: Vice President, Americas Professional Marketing
review_candidates.description: Department: Marketing Location: US-North Carolina-Raleigh Description The Vice President, Americas Professional Marketing leads professional and country marketing across the Americas. Reporting to the SVP, Global Brand, Consumer and Americas Marketing, this leader defines and executes strategies to acquire new professional customers, increase utilization across the existing customer base, and deliver innovative go-to-market approaches that support regional business goals. The role translates customer, market, and competitive insights into differentiated value propositions, portfolio priorities, and coordinated marketing plans across the United States, Canada, and Latin America. This leader also oversees regional portfolio marketing, professional customer engagement, and marketing readiness for new products and services in close partnership with country leadership, Sales, Global Marketing, Global Product, Clinical, Consumer Marketing, and iTero Marketing. Role expectations Set Professional Marketing Strategy Define and execute the Americas professional marketing strategy in alignment with regional business priorities and global marketing direction. Develop differentiated strategies for orthodontic, general dentistry, and dental service organization (DSO) customers based on market needs and growth opportunities. Translate customer, market, and competitive insights into opportunities to drive customer acquisition, utilization, and portfolio growth. Lead annual marketing planning and investment prioritization across channels and countries. Lead Portfolio Marketing Define regional product positioning, customer value propositions, and messaging in alignment with global brand and product strategy. Translate regional customer needs into portfolio recommendations, partnering with Global Portfolio teams on short- and long-term product and service priorities. Lead regional product lifecycle marketing, including adoption, portfolio mix, upgrades, and expansion opportunities. Develop recommendations related to product offerings, packaging, and pricing in partnership with business leadership, Finance, and Commercial Operations. Drive Professional Customer Engagement Lead integrated professional campaigns, communications, and engagement programs that strengthen customer relationships and increase adoption. Develop targeted engagement strategies across the professional customer journey using digital channels, customer relationship management (CRM) platforms, and customer insights. Build relationships with key customers, professional associations, and key opinion leaders, partnering with Clinical teams on clinically grounded content and education. Coordinate with Consumer Marketing to connect consumer demand with professional engagement while maintaining clear ownership of each audience. Lead Country And Launch Marketing Align country marketing plans around shared priorities while adapting execution to local customer and market needs. Lead professional marketing strategy and readiness for product and service launches, including positioning, messaging, campaigns, and customer-facing materials. Partner with Sales and country leadership to translate marketing strategy into coordinated launches and commercial activation. Partner with iTero Marketing to connect professional value propositions and customer engagement across the Align digital ecosystem while maintaining clear accountability for iTero business ownership. Drive Marketing Effectiveness Own the professional marketing budget, resource allocation, and return on marketing investment. Establish performance measures for customer engagement, acquisition, utilization, and campaign effectiveness in partnership with Finance and Commercial Operations. Review performance against plans and adjust investment and execution to improve business outcomes. Ensure marketing systems, processes, agencies, and vendors support effective and compliant execution. Build organizational capability and lead across functions Build professional, product, and portfolio marketing capabilities across regional and country teams. Foster collaboration across Sales, Consumer Marketing, Clinical, iTero, Global Marketing, and Global Product teams. Develop a strong leadership and specialist talent pipeline supported by clear development and succession plans. Uphold Align’s values and standards for brand, quality, ethics, and compliance. What We're Looking For Education: Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or other relevant advanced degree preferred. Experience: 15+ years of progressive marketing leadership experience, including responsibility for a sizable business-to-business (B2B) marketing organization. Industry knowledge: Experience in medical devices, dental, healthcare technology, or a related technology-enabled business. Marketing expertise: Demonstrated experience in professional marketing, product positioning, portfolio marketing, customer engagement, and product launches. Digital and analytical capability: Strong understanding of digital marketing, CRM, customer segmentation, and marketing analytics. Global and matrix leadership: Experience leading across countries, cultures, and complex matrixed organizations. Leadership and communication: Strong strategic, commercial, analytical, and communication skills, with the ability to translate insights into practical plans and measurable results. People leadership: Demonstrated ability to build high-performing teams, develop leadership talent, and lead through influence across functions and geographies. Collaborative leadership: Proven ability to build strong partnerships and drive collaboration across functions, business units, and country teams. Cross-geography experience: Demonstrated success leading across multiple geographies, while balancing regional consistency with local market needs. Consumer marketing understanding: Working knowledge of consumer marketing principles and the ability to connect consumer demand generation with professional customer engagement strategies. Leadership of leaders: Experience leading and developing senior leaders and people managers, with accountability for organizational capability, succession, and performance. Influence without authority: Demonstrated ability to align stakeholders, shape decisions, and deliver outcomes through influence in a complex global matrix without relying on direct reporting authority. Financial and performance marketing acumen: Strong understanding of P&L drivers, budget and investment trade-offs, return on marketing investment, and performance marketing measurement and optimization. Complementary Skills Executive presence and the ability to influence senior leaders and cross-functional partners. Ability to balance enterprise consistency with local market needs across the Americas. Experience managing significant budgets, external agencies, and strategic vendor relationships. Comfort operating in a fast-paced, highly regulated, and evolving commercial environment. review_candidates.title: Test Engineer
review_candidates.description: Zoek jij een technische en analytische uitdaging waarin jij écht impact maakt op het fundament van een internationale organisatie? Bij Global Automotive Group in Moerdijk vervangen we ons complete IT-landschap door een modern, zelfgebouwd ERP-systeem. Als Senior / Medior Test Engineer speel jij een sleutelrol in deze grootschalige IT-transformatie. Waarom deze functie jou uitdaagt We bouwen de komende jaren aan een nieuw, toekomstbestendig ERP-landschap dat al onze internationale ondernemingen gaat aansturen. De kern hiervan wordt ontwikkeld in OutSystems (low-code), naadloos geïntegreerd met standaardpakketten zoals Oracle Finance, PTV en Transics. Dit hybride landschap van SaaS- en on-premise toepassingen is constant in beweging. Met continue releases en complexe koppelingen is jouw testexpertise onmisbaar. Jij zorgt er met jouw analytische blik voor dat het nieuwe ERP-systeem vlekkeloos, schaalbaar en veilig presteert. Een omgeving waarin kwaliteit vooropstaat en waar geen dag hetzelfde is. Wat ga je doen als Test Engineer / QA Engineer? Binnen een dynamische Agile/Scrum-omgeving werk je nauw samen met ontwikkelaars, internationale bouwteams en specialisten op het gebied van performance- en penetratietesten. Jij bent van A tot Z verantwoordelijk voor de borging van de softwarekwaliteit van ons nieuwe ERP-systeem. Teststrategie & Uitvoering: Je ontwerpt, beheert en voert (complexe) testplannen uit voor zowel functionaliteiten als API-interfaces. Testautomatisering: Je richt geautomatiseerde testtooling in en onderhoudt deze om de efficiëntie en kwaliteitsborging naar een hoger niveau te tillen. Kwaliteitsbewaking: Je plant en voert functionele-, integratie-, performance-, acceptatie- en PEN-tests uit. CI/CD Integratie: Je ondersteunt releaseplannen en integreert testprocessen in de CI/CD-pipeline. Risico-analyse & Rapportage: Je signaleert proactief knelpunten en risico’s, stelt heldere testdocumentatie op en denkt oplossingsgericht mee over procesverbeteringen. Jouw profiel: Analytisch, proactief en kwaliteitsgericht Als ervaren tester houd je van complexe materie en deins je niet terug voor een omgeving die volop in opbouw is. Je bent communicatief sterk, werkt graag nauw samen met verschillende stakeholders en durft te staan voor de kwaliteit van het eindproduct. Opleiding & Ervaring: HBO/WO werk- en denkniveau (richting IT, Techniek of een vergelijkbare achtergrond) en minimaal 5 jaar ervaring als Test Engineer, QA Tester of Test Consultant. Vakkennis: Grondige kennis van moderne testmethodologieën (zoals TMAP, ISTQB) en testprocessen binnen Agile/Scrum. Testautomatisering: Aantoonbare ervaring met automated testing tooling en het inrichten van geautomatiseerde testscripts. Systeemkennis: Ervaring met low-code platformen (OutSystems) en SaaS-omgevingen is een sterke pré. Persoonlijkheid: Analytisch scherp, initiatiefrijk, kritisch op de inhoud en communicatief vaardig in het Nederlands en Engels. Wat bieden wij jou? Een uitdagende en bepalende rol in een grootschalig IT-veranderingstraject binnen een toonaangevende internationale automotive organisatie. Salaris & Bonussen: Een aantrekkelijk, marktconform salaris, 8% vakantiegeld en een winstafhankelijke eindejaarsuitkering. Vrije tijd: 25 vakantiedagen om op te laden. Pensioen & Toekomst: Uitstekende pensioenregeling waarbij wij 60% van de inleg vergoeden. Ontwikkeling: Onbeperkt toegang tot het online trainingsplatform GoodHabitz voor jouw persoonlijke en professionele groei. Extra's: Reiskostenvergoeding, een aantrekkelijke bedrijfsfitnessregeling en elke dag een verse, gezonde lunch in ons bedrijfsrestaurant voor slechts € 2,45. Klaar om het fundament te leggen voor ons nieuwe ERP-systeem? Wil jij je testexpertise inzetten binnen een uitdagende, internationale IT-omgeving in Moerdijk en écht impact maken?

review_candidates.title: Spanish Medical Interpreter Full Time
review_candidates.description: Company Description Grupo Noa International is a premier virtual call center serving the international direct response industry. The company operates in a multilingual environment, supporting English, Spanish, and many other languages to serve diverse global markets. Grupo Noa International currently handles customer service calls in over 29 countries, offering inbound customer service, outbound lead generation, and upselling on service calls. The organization focuses on providing high-quality, remote customer support solutions, creating opportunities for professionals who excel in communication and service. Team members collaborate virtually, contributing to an inclusive and globally connected work environment. Role Description This full-time remote role as a Spanish Medical Interpreter involves providing accurate and confidential interpretation between Spanish and English for patients, healthcare providers, and related stakeholders. Day-to-day tasks include facilitating clear, culturally sensitive communication during medical consultations, procedures, and follow-up calls, ensuring that medical information is conveyed faithfully and completely. The interpreter will listen carefully to speakers, interpret spoken language in real time, and may provide sight translation of medical documents or instructions when needed. The role requires adherence to professional ethics, including privacy and confidentiality standards, and consistent compliance with organizational and healthcare guidelines. The Spanish Medical Interpreter will collaborate with call center teams, follow established workflows, and use call center systems to document interactions as required. Qualifications Candidates should possess strong Medical Interpretation skills with a solid command of Medical Terminology. Candidates should possess abilities in Interpreting and Simultaneous Interpretation for Spanish and English communication. Candidates should possess Translation skills for written medical information as needed. Fluency in Spanish and English, with excellent listening and speaking skills in both languages. Prior experience as a medical interpreter, in healthcare call centers, or in clinical settings is highly beneficial. Knowledge of patient confidentiality standards and compliance with HIPAA or similar regulations. Strong customer service skills, professional telephone etiquette, and the ability to remain calm in sensitive situations. Reliable high-speed internet connection and a quiet, private workspace suitable for remote interpretation. Relevant certification in medical interpreting or formal training in healthcare communication is a plus.
